The clinic serves 4,200 registered patients.
The clinic runs 6 consultation rooms.
Opening hours are 08:00 to 19:00 on weekdays and 09:00 to 13:00 on Saturday.
Twelve nurses work in three shifts.
Four administrative staff work at the clinic.
Accreditation has been held since April 2022 and expires in April 2027.
Renewal requires an audit of infection-control records.
Attendance averages 180 consultations a day.
The January 2025 flu wave peaked at 310 consultations.
The no-show rate is 9 percent.
Reminder texts introduced in September 2024 cut the no-show rate from 14 percent.
A vaccine fridge failed overnight in March 2024.
2,100 euros of stock was discarded.
The fridge now has a networked temperature alarm checked every morning.
A paper log is kept as backup because the alarm once failed silently.
